source_evidence.quote: Death within 90 days after randomization occurred in 530 of 2433 patients (21.8%) in the BMES group and in 530 of 2413 patients (22.0%) in the saline group

findings.claim: The summary is labelled HR, although PLUS contributes a cumulative risk ratio reconstructed from counts and BaSICS contributes an HR. The mixed-measure approximation disclosed elsewhere should also be identified here.

findings.page_quote:
RETRIEVED_OUTCOME_NOT_REPORTED 
 harm span: IMPORTANCE: Saline (0.9% sodium chloride) is the most commonly administered intravenous fluid; however, its use may be associated with acute kidney injury (AKI) and increased mortality.

source_evidence.quote: In the buffered crystalloid group, 102 of 1067 patients (9.6%) developed AKI within 90 days after enrollment compared with 94 of 1025 patients (9.2%) in the saline group

findings.claim: SPLIT is labelled as not reporting AKI despite reporting arm-level AKI results. A refusal based on design variance does not establish outcome non-reporting.

findings.page_quote:
RETRIEVED_OUTCOME_NOT_REPORTED 
 harm span: Patients with established AKI requiring renal replacement therapy (RRT) were excluded.

source_evidence.quote: In the buffered crystalloid group, RRT was used in 38 of 1152 patients (3.3%) compared with 38 of 1110 patients (3.4%) in the saline group

findings.claim: SPLIT is labelled as not reporting RRT, but its abstract reports RRT results. The eligibility exclusion quoted on the page does not support that reporting label.

findings.claim: The PLUS renal-replacement-therapy row carries the mortality endpoint definition. Its endpoint metadata should identify new renal-replacement therapy; the extracted counts themselves match the source.

codex.note: The served CI limits are null, not zero; zero entries here are schema placeholders only. Strict effect-and-CI replay is unavailable because PLUS has null effect and CI fields. Supplementing those fields from the supplied counts gives RR=(530/2433)/(530/2413), with log variance 1/530-1/2433+1/530-1/2413. Combining this reconstructed RR with the BaSICS HR and CI gives PM tau²=0, Q≈0.1097 and the displayed recomputed HKSJ interval using the variance floor and t(1). The point estimate agrees. Full-triplet agreement cannot be established because the served interval was deliberately withheld under K2_SINGLE_DF; false does not indicate a conflicting served interval.
